verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a first-party Agent Skills feature: it discovers reusable instructions from your repo or home directory and loads them on demand through a native `skill` tool. It also lets you create custom agents with their own system prompts and permissions, so a developer can equip the agent for specialized tasks. Missing for 10: detailed docs on skill authoring format and structure, and independent or hands-on corroboration that skills work as described.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks

citations.quote: Agent skills let OpenCode discover reusable instructions from your repo or home directory. Skills are loaded on-demand via the native `skill` tool
This command will guide you through creating a new agent with a custom system prompt and permission configuration.
